name: BaseWard Bridge
description: Bind a BaseWard MCP server to the trusted message requester using short-lived credentials

exchangeToken.description: gw_ token of kind exchange; it cannot query data itself

serverName.description: MCP server name declared in mcp.servers

mcpPath.description: MCP mount path on the gateway

channel.description: Only resolve for this message channel

ttlMinutes.description: Optional requested lifetime; the gateway caps it

refreshSkewSeconds.description: Re-exchange this many seconds before expiry
